description.value: This study examined whether normalized gray matter volume of anterior and posterior insular subregions differed among quitters, relapsers, and nonsmokers, and whether gray matter volume was related to smoking behavior and nicotine dependence severity before smoking cessation treatment.

spans.text: In the present study, therefore, we compared gray matter volume (GMV) and seed-based structural covariance network (SCN) differences of the insular subregions among the smokers of quitting successfully (quitters), the smokers of relapsing (relapsers) and nonsmokers to determine whether the GMV and SCN of insular subregions prior to the target quit date relate to the treatment outcomes after smoking cessation therapy.
